name: Alfred
source:
The second prince of the Fasan Kingdom. The Witch's Curse makes him transform into a wolf. He lost one eye when he was very young, in an incident that makes him resent Matheus at the beginning. He's more physically developed than Matheus, and he considers the only important thing is training his body. He doesn't usually interfere with other people's businesses, and he has barely had any experience with women.

[from [url=http://www.otomate.jp/beast/flower_snow/chara/]Official site[/url]]
